notes: family: auction-money (ore sold for money, money invested for points). Remastered Edition rules (Alley Cat Games rulebook v14). Each round's Sell & Invest phase: spend money in £10 and £5 increments; a £10 investment earns the left number and a £5 investment the right number in the investment-board box matching the round and your position in the column. Box values are printed on the board, so enter the points gained per investment as repeating inputs. Unbuilt mines, money and unmined cubes score nothing. Lord Wallace solo mode: beat his score (not modelled). bggId not confirmed to be the Remastered listing; the original 2011 edition used different fixed investment boxes.
